title: Share existing Git-model and STUN SHA-1 compatibility implementation
goal: Vision: V-6. Remove duplicate SHA-1 compression/padding source while preserving every existing input framing, allocation, wrapping, endian, output, HMAC and model-admission policy. No functionality, tests or dependency removed.

reuse.searched: Model-license git_blob_sha1_hex and daemon-runtime NAT sha1_digest use the same RFC3174 compression/padding; existing paths pure-std utilities, existing RFC3174/RFC2202 vectors, existing model-license tests, and Commercial Apps references checked. No suitable shared SHA-1 API exists; SHA-256 streams have different buffers/read policies.
reuse.reason: Move the existing shared core into the already-linked paths crate. An owned Vec preserves each caller existing allocation and input framing without a second whole-message copy. No external source or new dependency.

coordination: Read-only Board1785 clear; parent approved expanded paths/nat/model-license scope as disjoint. Own worktree and target/home/tmp. Parent serializes publication; no external messages or push.
validation_plan: Run existing NAT RFC/HMAC and model-license cases unchanged plus paths tests.
Compare actual old/new raw and Git-prefixed functions over boundary/random vectors and independent Python hashlib answers.
Verify body reuse, original Vec allocation/framing and byte-identical old test tails. Run affected strict Clippy and formatting.

progress.validation: 113 paths tests, 3 model-license tests (1 explicit ignore), 9 NAT tests, strict affected Clippy, formatting and diff checks passed. Differential: 6,043 cases; 18,129 old/new and 18,129 independent-reference digest comparisons. Independent source review found no issues. Parent owns publication and closure.
